name: Retro 3D Radio
description: Isometric retro cassette radio built from CSS 3D cubes. Clicking the play button or sound icon starts audio, swings the radio, and opens the cassette cover.
contents: Isometric 3D radio with speaker grille, buttons, tuner slider and cassette
Sound on/off icon toggle above the radio
behavior: Click the orange button or the sound icon to play or stop audio (stop resets to start)
While playing the radio swings, its shadow shifts, the cover lifts and the button presses
editableByProps: Background, shadow, accent, case and icon colors
fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Radio sizing is based on viewport width (vw units), so it scales down on small screens
